name: studio_tiny
description: Plumbing smoke through Unsloth Studio on the hf-internal-testing random-weight pipelines (downloaded to $WORKSPACE/hf_tiny/<repo name>): every family Studio loads, in process and over HTTP, in seconds per cell. Output is noise by construction, so read these records for load / render success, timing overhead, determinism and memory only, never for quality. Sizes are 256px (Studio's minimum) because the tiny rope tables cannot reach larger latents on some families; tiny-zimage-pipe is left out on purpose (its rope overflows at 256px and the CUDA device assert poisons the process, see edge check tiny.rope_overflow_isolated), and tiny Wan is in-process only here (HTTP accepts only the 1280x704 presets, which the stock tiny rope cannot take; the edge suite covers HTTP video with the tiny-wan-pipe-rope128 variant fetch_tiny.py derives).
